name: Pot Pancakes

expect.physics: IDEAL: a batter that bubbles slightly (soda + vinegar) and sets into a golden disc in the oil. CURRENT: flour hits liquid and lumps, egg scrambles, soda fizzes into foam.

sim_gaps: No batter material: flour + liquid + egg should combine into a batter that sets with heat.

name: Pot Flatbread

expect.physics: IDEAL: a dough slab that browns and blisters on the hot pot. CURRENT: water + flour → lumps, oil + flour → roux; nothing becomes bread.

sim_gaps: No dough. Proposed: flour + small water ratio → DOUGH (chunk); DOUGH + heat → BREAD (browns).

name: Soda Bread (pot loaf)

expect.physics: IDEAL: buttermilk (milk + vinegar) reacts with soda and the gas makes the loaf rise. CURRENT: the soured milk fizzes foam immediately; flour lumps.

sim_gaps: Leavening: soda gas trapped in a batter/dough should raise it instead of making free foam.

name: Dry Caramel

expect.physics: IDEAL: sugar melts into a clear liquid, then turns amber caramel, then burns if pushed. CURRENT: sugar adds a caramel note above 160°C, then burns.

sim_gaps: No molten sugar/caramel material or amber color stages.

name: Caramel Sauce

expect.physics: IDEAL: sugar syrup cooks to amber, cream added carefully (it bubbles up violently). CURRENT: sugar dissolves into the water and nothing caramelizes because water caps the temperature at 100°C.

sim_gaps: Syrup boiling point should rise as sugar concentration rises (that's how caramel works).

name: Stovetop Custard

expect.physics: IDEAL: low heat + constant stirring thickens milk into custard; too hot and it scrambles. CURRENT: egg forms ribbons or scrambles; no thickening.

sim_gaps: Egg dispersed in hot liquid should add body (thicken) between 70–82°C before scrambling above.

expect.physics: IDEAL: a thin batter that sets into a sheet on the hot pot. CURRENT: flour stirred into cold milk disperses (slurry) and egg ribbons form when heated.
IDEAL: battered carrot clumps fry golden. CURRENT: flour hits the hot oil → roux; egg scrambles around the carrots; cumin blooms.

name: Honeycomb Toffee

expect.physics: IDEAL: soda added to hot caramel decomposes and foams it up into a golden honeycomb. CURRENT: soda only reacts with acid, so nothing foams; it adds bitterness.

sim_gaps: Soda should decompose with heat above ~80°C (foam) without acid.

name: Sweet Milk Flour Porridge

expect.physics: Flour stirred into cold milk disperses (no lumps) and thickens as it heats. Gentle heat avoids a boil-curdle.

sim_gaps: Slurried flour adds body immediately instead of only once hot (starch gelatinisation at ~70°C).
